RESP: the .do (Bookmark 6: fairness) sets 99 to missing and reverses (resp = 5 - x), so live resp 4 = Muy de acuerdo, 3 = De acuerdo, 2 = En desacuerdo, 1 = Muy en desacuerdo. TEXT (text_source=study_materials): instructions = the asterisked legend printed directly above question 13 (*Recuerde que estas preguntas se refieren únicamente a la [Policía Provincial/Policía de la Ciudad]*) followed by the question 13 stem verbatim (line wraps joined; stem identical in the documentation PDF, which omits the legend). The legend is kept because the questionnaire's format conventions define asterisked text as read aloud by the interviewer, and it supplies the referent of la policía in every item; the bracket inside it is the interviewer's fill (the respondent hears the name of their provincial or city police), kept as the questionnaire's own placeholder. Deviation: asterisks dropped and a period added after the bracket to join the legend to the stem; the source legend has no terminal punctuation. The same legend also precedes DS question 7. Not shipped: the interviewer bracket [Leer opciones] (not read aloud) and the chapter legend introducing DS question 1. item_text = the questionnaire statements with their final period; the .sav labels and documentation omit the period -- cosmetic, questionnaire form shipped. option_text = value labels as printed, which match the questionnaire response grid and the stem wording. Single section_id, no section_prompt. language=Spanish; translation_source=machine_translation: INDEC publishes the ENV 2017 in Spanish only; English in the _translated columns produced by IRW. Issues-page entry owed once live. STEP 3b: dictionary Description (agreement that police act fairly, honestly, and professionally) and the .do comment match IDS13a-d; 4 live items = 4 statements, resp 1-4 matches the 4-point agreement grid.
